labels.label: trial
labels.cushion: root chair surface report (actual UE cushion triangles)

correction_curve.gated_frames: hips at the seated height AND settled (hips speed <= 2.0 cm/s)

seam_blend.mode: full-pose seam blend into SeatedIdle first frame (loop tail)
seam_blend.weight: quintic smootherstep (zero 1st and 2nd derivative at both window ends)

no_penetration_lift.rule: A smooth non-negative lift curve that is never below a frame's own need: max filter, Gaussian, max with the need (the solve_per_frame envelope rule), then tapered (smootherstep) to exactly zero on and next to protected frames (support-gated frames and frames that are exactly the loop).

search.rule: (1) every frame passes; (2) the peak pelvis acceleration ratio (peak pelvis linear and angular acceleration over the whole clip, each relative to the fitted capture's own peak; the larger) at most SEAM_MAX_PEAK_RATIO, i.e. no abrupt boundary: the blend accelerates the pelvis no more than the captured motion itself, and no sole slides faster while touching the floor (lowest gap <= +1 cm) than that sole's own fastest touching motion in the fitted capture; (3) the most captured frames kept unchanged (neither blended nor lifted); (4) the smallest peak ratio.

seam_blend.support_rule: seat + sole support gate on the settled seated frames and every frame that is already the loop; every other frame: no penetration (lowest >= band low edge)

left_sole.unseated_note: stepping frames lift a foot genuinely; only penetration is counted there
